get.description: Returns a list of opportunity roles based on a filter and set of values. Required Permissions: Read-Only Opportunity, Read-Write Named Opportunity

parameters.name: customObjectLookupRequest
parameters.description: Optional JSON request for retrieving opportunity roles with compound keys

parameters.name: filterType
parameters.description: The role field to filter on. Searchable fields can be retrieved with the Describe Opportunity call.

parameters.name: filterValues
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of field values to return records for

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response

parameters.name: batchSize
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return in the response. Max and default is 300

parameters.name: nextPageToken
parameters.description: Paging token returned from a previous response

marketoGUID.description: Unique GUID of the custom object records

reasons.description: List of reasons why an operation did not succeed. Reasons are only present in API responses and should not be submitted

seq.description: Integer indicating the sequence of the record in response. This value is correlated to the order of the records included in the request input. Seq should only be part of responses and should not be submitted.

code.description: Error code of the error. See full list of error codes here

message.description: Message describing the cause of the error

batchSize.description: Maximum number of records to return in the response. Max and default is 300

fields.description: List of fields to return. If not specified, will return the following fields: marketoGuid, dedupeFields, updatedAt, createdAt, filterType

filterType.description: Field to search on. Valid values are: dedupeFields, idFields, and any field defined in searchableFields attribute of Describe endpoint. Default is dedupeFields

input.description: Search values when using a compound key. Each element must include each of the fields in the compound key. Compound keys are determined by the contents of "dedupeFields" in the Describe result for the object

nextPageToken.description: Paging token returned from a previous response

message.description: Message describing the reason for the status of the operation

errors.description: Array of errors that occurred if the request was unsuccessful

moreResult.description: Boolean indicating if there are more results in subsequent pages

nextPageToken.description: Paging token given if the result set exceeded the allowed batch size

result.description: Array of results for individual records in the operation, may be empty

warnings.description: Array of warnings given for the operation
